# proxmox_node_ceph_mds_daemons (Data Source)

Lists Ceph MDS daemons from `/nodes/{node}/ceph/mds`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_mds_daemons" "m" { node = "pve-1" }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Read-Only

- `daemons` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--daemons))
